<script>
[0] action: Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van.
[1] action: On the dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop.
[2] sound: Aruni's voice message plays.
[3] dialogue Aruni, voice_message: Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan baya hithenawa.
[4] action: Mudalali calls.
[5] dialogue Mudalali, phone: Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna.
[6] action: Dinu looks at the red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.
</script>
